summary.text: Submit your request online or call the hotline. Supporting documents will be requested for assessment.

steps.name: Choose a method
steps.text: Submit your request through the MediShield Life e-Service, or call the MediShield Life hotline at 1800-222-3399.

steps.name: Provide documents
steps.text: Provide supporting documents when requested for assessment.

quotes.text: You can submit your request through the MediShield Life e-Service (https://medishieldlife.moh.gov.sg/) or call our MediShield Life hotline at 1800-222-3399.
Do note that supporting documents will be requested for assessment.
